Consequently, the Risk of Material Misstatement (RMM) due to fraud is elevated to CRITICAL.
electronic_working_papers.recommended_substantive_action: 1. Management must immediately enforce the Principle of Least Privilege by revoking wildcard privileges. 2. Engagement teams must refuse reliance on ITGCs and execute 100% substantive testing on all ledger balances hosted within this cloud environment.
